name: Abezames (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and yellow, charged with a white Saint Michael the Archangel on the red and three green ears of wheat on the yellow.
history: The neighbourhood assembly of the town council of Abezames, in session on 28 April 2010, approved the heraldic arms and municipal flag of the town; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes, red with Saint Michael the Archangel in white at the hoist and yellow with a sheaf of three green ears of wheat at the fly. The elements and colours of the arms and flag highlight cultural, religious and economic aspects important to the municipality.
